name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding one kettlebell with both hands or two kettlebells in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight fixed bend in your knees, pack your lats, and push your hips smoothly backward.
Lower the weight close along your legs with a flat back until you feel a clear stretch across your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward strongly to stand tall and squeeze your glutes without leaning back.
tips: Keep your spine flat and stop descending once your hips stop traveling backward.
Let the weight glide straight down close to your shins rather than drifting forward.
